social_formats.description: Danced in small groups of three, typically two men and one woman, moving in a V formation.

movement_profile.formation_and_space: Groups of three dancers moving together in a V formation
movement_profile.partnering: Trio structure, typically two men and one woman

signature_moves.description: Three dancers position themselves in a V shape and travel together in synchronized steps.
signature_moves.name: V-Formation Trio Shift

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Breaking the trio V formation during movement.

music_profile.sound_description: A crisp, upbeat Aegean instrumental track featuring a prominent lead violin carrying a fast-paced melody in 2/4 meter, historically anchored by the drone and reed sound of the tsampouna bagpipe.
music_profile.vocal_style: Historically vocal sing-along by dancers; modern style is primarily instrumental

basic_steps: Arrange group into a trio of three dancers (typically two men and one woman)
Form a tight V shape formation
Step in synchronization to the 2/4 meter, following the violin melody
teaching.level_notes: Beginners focus on maintaining the trio V formation and keeping step with the 2/4 time signature.
